rationale: The workflow already contains a Gradle dependency cache step (actions/cache, caching ~/.gradle/caches and ~/.gradle/wrapper, keyed on runner.os plus hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties'), with restore-keys). This is exactly the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE optimization supported by the retrieved evidence (measured Gradle-cache experiments). Because an equivalent cache already exists, the pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies, so adding another cache would be redundant rather than an improvement. Other candidate patterns lack met preconditions: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history, but ci_history reports no completed runs; P-LIT-FAIL-FAST requires a matrix, but the workflow has a single job; change-filter and cancel-stale patterns would alter required-check semantics and are not supported by the repository context. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is.
